technical_quality: Frontal PA film, minimal rotation (medial clavicle ends roughly symmetric about the spinous processes). Shallow inspiration with high diaphragms (about 7 posterior ribs visible), which exaggerates the cardiac and mediastinal silhouette. Obese habitus with large bilateral breast soft-tissue shadows obscuring both lung bases; the chin/mandible with dental work projects over the upper mediastinum. Apices, lateral chest walls and both costophrenic regions included; penetration adequate centrally. Diagnostic but suboptimal for the lung bases.

devices.type: Metallic dental restorations / dental prosthesis (multiple crowns or bridge work)
devices.location: Oral cavity, superimposed over the maxilla/mandible at the top-centre of the film, above the cervical spine

devices.type: Radiographic side marker (check-mark-shaped, probably a partially imaged L marker)
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, i.e. patient's left shoulder region, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Cardiomegaly: enlarged, globular cardiac silhouette with the left heart border displaced toward the left chest wall; estimated transverse cardiac diameter ~19 cm with CTR approximately 0.55-0.6 (partly accentuated by shallow inspiration)

Marked elevation of the right hemidiaphragm with a dense homogeneous right basal opacity having a smooth convex upper margin; favours eventration or subpulmonic effusion, but right lower lobe collapse/consolidation cannot be excluded on this single view
Prominent, unfolded/tortuous thoracic aorta with a bulging aortic knob and widened superior mediastinum, consistent with age-related aortic ectasia/unfolding
Mild central pulmonary vascular prominence / hilar fullness, likely accentuated by low lung volumes; no frank interstitial edema, no focal consolidation in the left lung, no pneumothorax

description_zh: 正面（PA）胸部X光，吸氣不足、橫膈位置偏高，雙側乳房軟組織陰影重疊於下肺野，影像上緣可見金屬假牙。心臟陰影明顯擴大，心胸比約0.55–0.6（橫徑約19公分），左心緣向左側胸壁延伸，主動脈弓突出且迂曲、上縱膈增寬，符合心臟擴大合併主動脈迂曲。右側橫膈明顯抬高，右下肺野呈均質緻密影、上緣平滑呈弧形，考慮橫膈膨升或肺底積液，無法完全排除右下葉實質病灶；左肺野大致清晰，未見明顯肺水腫或氣胸。未見心律調節器、中央靜脈導管、氣管內管或胸管等裝置，僅影像右上角見側別標記。
